exact_continuation: Same-generation abandoned reservation cleanup. Compare deterministic same-task resume, explicit cancel epoch, parent-generation-only takeover, wall-clock lease expiry, lease expiry plus sink-time cell revalidation, and append-only abandonment certificate. Enumerate owner disappearance, scheduler interruption, duplicate task rematerialization, cancellation, late old-owner return, response loss, rate-limit interruption, and external-effect ambiguity. Find a Chat-native zero-quota cleanup rule that restores liveness without reintroducing stale-owner effects; otherwise isolate the minimal unresolved authority needed.

mechanism_conclusion.ancestor_only: Mapping each predicate only to its smallest static ancestor without ancestor/descendant conflict propagation is unsafe.
mechanism_conclusion.global_root: Safe but maximally coarse in disjoint-claim false exclusion and shared-authority touch.
mechanism_conclusion.liveness_gap: For current-generation abandonment, forbidding time-based steal preserves safety but can strand a reservation. Safe cleanup/resume without manual intervention or hosted coordination is the next unresolved child.
mechanism_conclusion.ordered_strong: A rootless deterministic multi-cell reservation can be safe in this tested repository-local scope if partial acquisition carries no authority, the full expected cell set is durably recorded, all claimants acquire cells in one canonical order, a deterministic reservation ID supports ambiguous readback, same-generation time-expiry steal is forbidden, and parent-generation supersession fences old owners.

phase1_assessment.repository_local_ordered_reservation: No hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package service, cloud credit, external coordinator, manual user execution, or incremental monetary cost is required for the tested repository-local state machine. Lightweight repository CAS is transport only.
phase1_assessment.residual_richer_mode_or_manual_user_exec: none for tested repository-local protocol; arbitrary protected external sink atomic participation remains unresolved and not accepted
